verdict.rationale: Orama's AnswerSession/answer-engine feature explicitly turns queries into AI-generated straight answers with sourced citations ('ChatGPT-like experiences'), and Orama Cloud's MCP server lets AI interfaces (ChatGPT, Cursor) interact with and query the underlying data directly, both first-party documented capabilities. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of proactive suggestion generation (vs. purely query-driven answers), and no demonstration of unsolicited insight surfacing without a user prompt.
